bca_resource_district_replace_controller = {
    optimize_memory
    if = {
        limit = {
            any_deposit = {
                is_blocker = yes
            }
        }
        set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_build_district_d0
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            has_generator_designation = yes
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_energy
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_betharian
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_wilderness_energy
                }

            }
            if = {
                limit = { bca_district_d1_reach_planet_max = no }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_district_d2
                            value > bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
                        }
                        NOT = { has_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan }
                    }
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_remove_district_d2
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_build_district_d1
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_advance_controller_order
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_district_d3
                            value > bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
                        }
                        NOT = { has_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan }
                    }
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_remove_district_d3
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_build_district_d1
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_advance_controller_order
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = { has_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan }
                        check_variable_arithmetic = {
                            which = value:num_district_d0
                            value > 1
                        }
                    }
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_remove_district_d0
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_plan_build_district_d1
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan
                    set_planet_flag = bca_pf_advance_controller_order
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_energy
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_betharian
                    has_planet_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_wilderness_energy
                }

            }

                limit = { bca_district_d2_reach_planet_max = no }

                            which = value:num_district_d1

                        NOT = { has_planet_flag = bca_pf_has_district_remove_plan }
